title: Confirm earliest start date with current institution
detail: Sample blocker: the applicant's earliest start date is not yet confirmed with the current institution. Compatibility of current openings with that start is unknown — do not assume an employer can wait; check each role's hiring timeline before any submission.

title: Obtain official transcript copy
detail: Resolved 2026-11-18 (sample): an official transcript copy was received and filed with the sample data kit, so it is available for any application that asks for one.
